landing.rankingShotBody: One ranking, updated the moment a result goes in. Pull it up on the club TV and let it settle the argument.
landing.finalBody: Start a club, invite the regulars, record tonight's matches.
landing.altHero: PoolClubs on a phone, showing the club ranking
landing.altRanking: The overall ranking screen on a large display
landing.altDrill: A drill with its table diagram and scoring
landing.altChallenge: An open challenge between two club players
landing.eyebrow: For pool clubs and their players
landing.title: Every match counts.
landing.subtitle: Log every match, watch the Elo ranking move, and train with drills that show progress.
landing.ctaNote: Free, and no app store needed. It runs in the browser and installs to your home screen.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything a club argues about, settled
landing.f1Body: Every result moves the table. Overall and daily rankings, so a good night counts for something too.
landing.f2Body: Challenge anyone in the club, agree the format, record the score. The feed keeps the history.
landing.f3Body: A shared drill library, personal plans, and progress charts that show whether the practice is working.
landing.f4Body: Invite players with a join code. Members only, so the ranking stays inside the club.
landing.installIosBody: Open in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
landing.installAndroidBody: Open in Chrome, tap the menu, then Install app.
landing.installDesktopBody: Click the install icon in the address bar, or just use it in a tab.
landing.storeSoon: Native iOS and Android apps are on the way.
landing.footer: Made by pool players for pool players.
